description: Screenshot plan for SandboxPilot (github.com/LeanBytes/SandboxPilot). Ships with MacPacker so any screenshot driver knows how to launch MacPacker into each state. MacPacker's launch parameters are generic and app-independent; this file is the glue that tells the driver which parameters, scenarios and appearances to use. The driver stages `testAssets.archive` somewhere the (sandboxed) app can read it, substitutes {archive} in the scenario arguments, then runs every scenario x appearance x language.
